about: The Tracks section of /conference, in this order. scripts/gen-schedule.mjs lists under each track every session of scripts/data/schedule.json whose "track" is that key, with its day, time and hall, the speakers' photos and a link to the session in the schedule; Expo Hall talks count as Innovation Talks, and a keynote with no track goes under "@keynotes". Only the words here are written by hand: what each track covers ("about") and who it is for ("for"). Keep them general enough to stay true when a session moves; the session list carries the detail. A track in schedule.json that is missing here still shows, by its key, and the generator says so. Plain English, no dashes as punctuation (organiser, 12 Nov 2026).

tracks.name: Keynotes
tracks.about: Maharashtra's ministers and senior leaders from MeitY, the IndiaAI Mission and the state government open the conference on Day 1, with every hall gathered in Homi J. Bhabha Hall.

tracks.name: Government & Public Sector AI
tracks.about: How ministries, national missions and state departments are using AI in public services, from the IndiaAI Mission and Aadhaar to forest protection and population-scale public infrastructure.
tracks.for: Government officials, public sector CIOs and GovTech teams.

tracks.name: GenAI & Agentic AI
tracks.about: What leaders are doing as generative AI moves from pilots to autonomous agents that run parts of the business.
tracks.for: CIOs, CTOs, AI product leaders and GenAI teams.

tracks.name: Enterprise AI
tracks.about: Turning AI spend into measurable business value, building the teams that deliver it, and lessons from running AI agents across a company.
tracks.for: CXOs, transformation heads and engineering leaders.

tracks.name: BFSI & FinTech AI
tracks.about: AI for financial inclusion in banking, lending and payments, and for insurance that reaches more of Bharat.
tracks.for: Leaders in banking, insurance, payments and fintech.

tracks.name: Healthcare & Life Sciences AI
tracks.about: AI for access, affordability and outcomes in care, privacy-preserving health data, and AI from molecules to medicines.
tracks.for: Hospital and pharma leaders, health researchers and healthtech founders.

tracks.name: Telecom AI
tracks.about: How AI runs the networks and connectivity behind Digital India.
tracks.for: Telecom operators, network leaders and enterprise connectivity buyers.

tracks.name: Education & Skills AI
tracks.about: Using AI to improve learning outcomes, from assessment to measurable impact.
tracks.for: Vice chancellors, academic leaders, EdTech founders and skilling bodies.

tracks.name: Media & Entertainment AI
tracks.about: Content, creativity and personalisation as AI changes film, streaming and short-form drama.

tracks.name: Sales & Marketing AI
tracks.about: AI-driven growth engines for sales, marketing and distribution.
tracks.for: CMOs, sales and distribution heads, and growth teams.

tracks.name: Agricultural AI
tracks.about: Using AI to raise farmers' income, in farming and in fisheries.
tracks.for: Agriculture and fisheries officials, agritech founders and researchers.

tracks.name: Innovation Talks
tracks.about: Exhibitors show what they have built, in short talks back to back on the Expo Hall stage, with a few longer talks in other halls.
tracks.for: Anyone choosing an AI product or partner.

tracks.name: Hands-on Workshops
tracks.about: Practical sessions in Raman Theatre (Centrum Hall B), from building enterprise AI with forward-deployed engineers to fine-tuning LLMs and speech recognition.
tracks.for: Engineers and data scientists who want to build, not only listen. Seats are limited.
